SELECT SUM(t1.gross_amount) / COUNT(t1.order_id) AS 客单价
FROM fact_order AS t1
INNER JOIN dim_date AS t2 ON t1.date_id = t2.date_id
WHERE t1.order_status != '已取消' AND t2.year = 2025

  SUM(CASE WHEN d.month = 12 AND d.date_id BETWEEN 20251201 AND 20251231 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS this_month_gmv,
  SUM(CASE WHEN d.month = 11 AND d.date_id BETWEEN 20251101 AND 20251130 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS last_month_gmv,
  ROUND(
    (SUM(CASE WHEN d.month = 12 AND d.date_id BETWEEN 20251201 AND 20251231 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) - 
     SUM(CASE WHEN d.month = 11 AND d.date_id BETWEEN 20251101 AND 20251130 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END)) / 
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN d.month = 11 AND d.date_id BETWEEN 20251101 AND 20251130 THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) * 100, 2
  ) AS gmv_mom_growth_rate
FROM fact_order f
JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id
WHERE f.order_status != '已取消'
  AND d.date_id BETWEEN 20251101 AND 20251231;

FROM fact_order f

WHERE f.order_status != '已取消' AND f.is_new_customer = 1 AND YEAR(d.full_date) = 2025
GROUP BY MONTH(d.full_date)
ORDER BY 新客订单数 DESC
LIMIT 1
